extensions.scope: Rain on Glass Nature wallpaper only.

layout.photograph: Centered cover crop in desktop and portrait

motion.name: simulation-step
motion.purpose: Autonomous settling, adhesion, gravity, volume-conserving coalescence and drainage.

motion.name: trail-fade
motion.purpose: Gradual erasure of slender wet residue.

motion.name: render-limit
motion.value: 30 FPS default; host range 1–60, maximum 15 with reduced motion
motion.purpose: Bound rendering work while honoring host performance settings.

rendering.technique: WebGL height-field refraction with curved reflections and directional highlights
rendering.backgroundBlur: Cached Canvas blur, recalculated only when softness changes
rendering.contextLoss: Show bundled photograph; rebuild GPU resources on restoration without resetting simulated drops
rendering.reducedMotion: Still frame after 12 simulated seconds; explicit host resume permits animation
rendering.visibility: Stop scheduling while hidden; resume when visible if not paused
rendering.preview: Seeded still frame through ?preview=<seconds>, clamped to 0–120

package.textureSource: Local photograph embedded as a data URL in background.js for safe host file-origin upload

components.name: Wet glass scene
components.description: Sharp varied water beads over a muted blue-hour city photograph; no HUD or embedded controls.

components.name: Graphics fallback
components.description: Full viewport bundled photograph with a bottom recovery message.

narrative.overview: Realistic autonomous rain settles, merges and flows over glass. Crisp foreground water refracts original blue-grey and amber photographic scenery, with cached background blur and fading slender trails.
dos: Preserve restrained reflections and cached blur.
Keep settings in the host and honor renderer lifecycle.
Regenerate background.js when replacing the photograph.
donts: Do not add a HUD or embedded controls.
Do not present the wallpaper as a live desktop capture or window overlay.
